AP (pub 06:03 BST): 1,000 days since 7 Oct 2023 attack; 73,000+ Palestinians killed since; ~1,200 Israelis killed in original attack; both sides weary, ceasefire fragile, Israeli divisions deepening ahead of looming election. Corroborated: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/2/gaza-wars-1000-days-90-of-strip-destroyed-80-seized-by-israel (90% destroyed, 80% under Israeli control, Board of Peace falters); Le Monde https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/07/02/how-israel-is-marking-1-000-days-since-hamas-s-october-7-attacks_6755071_4.html (commemorations + protests outside PM residence)
